events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Adopt Pagan Religion?

options.text: Adopt [religion].
Not right now.

events.text: Followers of [religion] arrives at court, asking you to become a divine ruler by adopting their Pagan Religion. Should we take [religion] as our State Religion? Doing so will increase Happiness in [religion] Cities and improve relations with families who follow [religion].

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Adopt State Religion?

options.text: Adopt [religion].
Not right now.

events.text: Worshippers from all over the nation arrive at court, seeking direction. Is it time to adopt [religion] as our State Religion? Doing so will increase Happiness in [religion] Cities and improve relations with families who follow [religion].

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Autarky or Trade League

options.text: [rival] will be self-sufficient.
Trade with outsiders benefits everyone.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: As [rival] grows, so does the world surrounding us. It is time for the court to define its views on what lies beyond our borders. Shall we institute policies of strict Autarky or should we begin the formation of a Trade League?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Centralization or Vassalage

options.text: Centralization will strengthen our power.
Vassalage trusts our subjects to govern.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: Nobles in the court insist that we clarify our stance on administration. Do we support policies of Centralization or Vassalage? What shall we decree?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Coin Debasement or Monetary Reform

options.text: We will mint as much money as we need.
Purer coins will keep our economy strong.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: Members of the treasury have come to discuss the nation's financial situation. They suggest sweeping changes to the current system, including either Coin Debasement or Monetary Reform. Which do we support?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Colonies or Serfdom

options.text: The nation must grow and expand.
Our people should work their own land.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: Nobles in the court insist that we clarify our stance on economic systems. Do we support policies of Colonies abroad, or do we explore Serfdom here at home? What shall we decree?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Divine Rule or Legal Code

options.text: The people should worship me as a god.
Reason should be the basis of government.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: Critics decry the court's silence on religious policy. They say it is past time that we declare our stance, whether we support Divine Rule or Legal Code. What is our decree?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Epics or Exploration

options.text: Let us share our own stories.
The world has many tales to tell.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: The court has opened debate on the topic of cultural enrichment, and we are of two minds on the matter. We can invest in national [law], or we can rely on [law] to bring us new experiences. What shall we decree?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Guilds or Elites

options.text: Labor and merit lead to great works.
Lineage produces the finest craftsmen.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: Merchants have petitioned the court for months over the formation of trade guilds, which would give them leverage in the marketplace. Of course, our nobles and powerful vassal families wish to maintain their exclusive access to fine goods and services. It is time to choose between Guilds and Elites.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Iconography or Calligraphy

options.text: Images are a language we all understand.
Writing gives power to those who wield it.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: Scholars in the court insist that we clarify our stance on administration and literacy. Do we support the broad use of Iconography, or do we wish our scribes to practice fine Calligraphy? What do we decree?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Monotheism or Polytheism

options.text: There is only one true God.
We respect the old and the new gods.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: Is there one spirit with many faces, or a single divine entity? Our mystics wish to know if the truth lies in Monotheism or Polytheism. What does the court suggest?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Philosophy or Engineering

options.text: We have much to learn about ourselves.
Put the mind to practical use.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: Thinkers in the court question the best path forward. The court can focus its energy on the mysteries of Philosophy, or we can focus on the practical applications of Engineering. What shall we do?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Pilgrimage or Holy War

options.text: All the world should see our holy places.
We must passionately defend the faithful.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: The streets ring with calls for both peace and conflict, as the people struggle to understand [rival]'s religious future. We must be bold and impose the court's will. Do we support Pilgrimage or the tenets of Holy War?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Professional Army or Volunteers

options.text: Lasting security is bought with gold.
None fight like a man protecting his home.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: [rival] is in need of a decision regarding its military training. Some in court support the creation of a Professional Army, while others wish to rely on Volunteers to fight. What is our decision?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Slavery or Freedom

options.text: We will keep slaves.
Our subjects will be free.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: [rival] is in need of a decision regarding its labor force. Some in court support the system of Slavery, while others wish to keep Freedom a virtue. What shall we decree?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Tolerance or Orthodoxy

options.text: Even heathens may live among us in peace.
One true path leads to godliness.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: Critics decry the court's silence on religious policy. They say it is past time that we declare our stance, whether we support Tolerance or Orthodoxy. What is our decree?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Tyranny or Constitution

options.text: My word is law!
Society shall be bound by rules.
We will not decide right now.
The court will choose the laws.

events.text: The time has come. We can either seize control of the court and adopt Tyranny or we can allow for the creation of a national Constitution. The people await our answer...
